title: Interaction-as-a-Judge
abstract: arXiv:2610.17895v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents are tasked with producing sophisticated interactive applications such as websites, desktop applications, and games. While humans assess these applications interactively, current automated LLM evaluations primarily focus on code analysis and unit tests. This mismatch can cause LLM judges to miss failures that are immediately apparent to human users. We study Interaction-as-a-Judge, an evaluation paradigm where computer-use agents (CUAs) directly interact with an application. We demonstrate that Interaction-as-a-Judge can improve both evaluation and generation of interactive applications. To this end, we collect and release two complementary datasets: $6,858$ pairs of applications with human preferences and corresponding agent traces, and $222$ applications with human-verified requirement labels. Relative to standard non-interactive approaches, we find that Interaction-as-a-Judge improves evaluation in terms of predicting h

translated_abstract: 编程智能体的任务是产出复杂的交互式应用，例如网站、桌面应用和游戏。人类在评估这些应用时会以交互方式进行，而当前自动化的LLM评估主要集中于代码分析和单元测试。这种不匹配会导致LLM评判者遗漏那些对人类用户而言一目了然的缺陷。我们研究了“交互即裁判”，这是一种由计算机操作智能体（CUA）直接与应用进行交互的评估范式。我们证明“交互即裁判”能够同时改进交互式应用的评估与生成。为此，我们收集并发布了两个互补的数据集：包含人类偏好及对应智能体操作轨迹的6,858对应用，以及带有经人类验证的需求标签的222个应用。相较于标准的非交互式方法，我们发现“交互即裁判”在预测h……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出“交互即裁判”评估范式，让计算机操作智能体直接与应用交互来进行评估和生成，弥补了传统基于代码分析与单元测试的自动评估和人类交互式评估之间的差距，并发布了包含人类偏好对与经人类验证需求标签的两个数据集。
en_tdlr: Proposes Interaction-as-a-Judge, an evaluation paradigm where computer-use agents directly interact with applications to improve both evaluation and generation of interactive apps, bridging the gap between code-based automated evaluation and human interactive assessment, supported by two newly released datasets with human preferences and human-verified requirement labels.
